reference_sql:
WITH order_values AS (  -- one row per order of January to June 2025
  SELECT order_id, channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_value
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_id, channel
)
SELECT channel,
       ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value), 0) AS median_order_eur
FROM order_values
GROUP BY channel

SELECT DISTINCT channel,
       ROUND(MEDIAN(order_value) OVER (PARTITION BY channel), 0) AS median_order_eur

SELECT t.channel, ROUND(MEDIAN(t.order_value), 0) AS median_order_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per order of January to June 2025
  SELECT order_id, channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_value
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_id, channel
) AS t
GROUP BY t.channel

       ROUND(MEDIAN(order_value) OVER (PARTITION BY channel), 0) AS median_order_eur
FROM order_values
other_way.tradeoff: MEDIAN over a window puts the median on every order row, so it needs DISTINCT to give one row per channel.

solver.query:
WITH ov AS (
  SELECT channel, order_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_value
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY channel, order_id
)
SELECT channel, ROUND(MEDIAN(order_value), 0) AS median_order_eur
FROM ov
GROUP BY channel
